<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Pool" name="Sales" processRef="Process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="Lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Select</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Tell</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Process</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Assistant" name="Sales Assistant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Call</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gw_Interested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Note</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Next</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start" name="Leads to check" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Check" name="Check the open leads" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select" name="Select the top five leads" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Tell" name="Tell the Sales Assistant to call the contact person" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Call" name="Call the customer" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gw_Interested" name="Customer interested?" default="F_no" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Note" name="Send a note to the Manager" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Next" name="Call the next customer" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Process" name="Process the lead" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End" name="Lead processed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="Start" targetRef="Task_Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="Task_Check" targetRef="Task_Select" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="Task_Select" targetRef="Task_Tell" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="Task_Tell" targetRef="Task_Call" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="Task_Call" targetRef="Gw_Interested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_yes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gw_Interested" targetRef="Task_Note" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_no" name="no" sourceRef="Gw_Interested" targetRef="Task_Next" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" sourceRef="Task_Next" targetRef="Gw_Interested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" sourceRef="Task_Note" targetRef="Task_Process" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F8" sourceRef="Task_Process" targetRef="End" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
